name: Bone Quarry
blurb: An open pit of bleached earth where something vast was dismantled, stone tools scattered between ribs large as archways.
art_prompt: Massive ivory bones jutting from rust-red clay. Bone-white ribs curved like cathedral arches. Black basalt tool-marks scarring pale surfaces. Dust-choked air. No sky.

name: Brackwater Fen
blurb: A vast marsh of rust-colored water and sunken timber where the air itself tastes of copper and decay.
art_prompt: Rust-red water stretching flat, half-submerged tree trunks skeletal and black, silt banks ochre and cracked, brackish vapor rising, distant limestone ridges bone-pale and featureless.

name: Corroded Meridian
blurb: A vast clockwork observatory where brass gears the size of keeps have seized and split, leaking caustic fluids that pool in geometric basins and eat through stone.
art_prompt: Massive interlocking brass gears, some fractured and weeping rust-red liquid. Geometric stone channels carved into floor. Verdigris-stained copper domes, one collapsed. Pools of luminous amber acid reflecting broken astrolabes and calibration rods.

name: The Molten Vein
blurb: A collapsed forge-temple where magma still flows through cracked marble halls, and the air shimmers with heat that warps sound itself.
art_prompt: Fractured white and grey marble columns half-submerged in rust-orange magma. Black obsidian slag heaped against golden-veined stone. Thermal shimmer rising from lava channels carved deep into the floor. Charred wooden beams jutting from rubble. The colour of old blood in shadow where magma-light doesn't reach.

name: Riftwound Expanse
blurb: A vast plateau where reality has split open—jagged chasms leak radiant void-light, and the sky hangs in fractured plates like a shattered mirror.
art_prompt: Fractured obsidian plateaus, violet void-fissures splitting earth, floating geometric shards of stone suspended in sickly green light, edges crumbling into absolute darkness, no horizon.

name: Shattered Meridian
blurb: A vast clockwork mechanism lies broken across impossible angles, its gears frozen mid-turn as reality splinters around them.
art_prompt: Colossal brass gears tilted at wrong angles, some half-phased into void. Rust-red oil pooling on obsidian. Fractured sky bleeding sickly amber. Shattered bronze plates. Black fissures in the metal floor spreading outward.
